svg.text: STAGE 396 · TOPIC 36 FAQ
WebRTC FlexFEC/Opus LBRR Spiral & RFC 2198 RED Nesting Guard
FEC Overhead <=25% BWE Anti-Congestion Spiral (P785) & RFC 2198 RED Nesting Depth <=2 + 14-Bit Offset Gate (P786)
1. WebRTC FlexFEC / Opus LBRR Anti-Spiral Gate (P785)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Unbounded 2x/3x FEC Triggers Self-Congestion Collapse
• Queue congestion drops 5% packets -> sender enables 100% FlexFEC + LBRR
• Doubling bitrate on a full router queue spikes loss from 5% to 48%
• Result: Self-induced congestion spiral collapses call within 3 seconds
✅ Production Pattern: Downshift Opus Rate First + <=25% FEC Cap (P785)
1. Sub-Rate First: Downshift Opus source rate (32->16kbps) before adding FEC
2. FEC Overhead Ceiling: Clamp total FEC + LBRR overhead to <=25% of BWE
3. Headroom Guard: Keep total (Audio + FEC) bitrate <= 85% of TWCC BWE
4. Zero Self-Inflicted Drop: Recovers random loss without overflowing queues
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcFlexfecOpusLbrr...):
clampedMaxFecOverheadPct <= 25% && clampedMaxTotalAudioFecBwePct <= 85%
2. RFC 2198 RED Nesting Bomb & 14-Bit Offset Gate (P786)
❌ Anti-Pattern: Recursive RED-in-RED Bomb & 14-Bit Timestamp Wrap
• Malformed RFC 2198 block header sets block PT = RED PT (recursive loop)
• 14-bit timestamp offset >16,383 ticks wraps around & corrupts NetEQ playout
• Result: Media gateway stack overflow crash & 340ms out-of-order audio
✅ Production Pattern: Zero RED Recursion + <=2 Blocks & Offset Cap (P786)
1. Zero Recursive PT: Reject any RFC 2198 block whose PT equals RED PT
2. Redundancy Block Cap: Clamp redundant blocks per packet to <= 2
3. 14-Bit Offset Bound: Enforce timestamp offset <= 4,800 ticks (100ms@48k)
4. Memory-Safe Unpacking: Prevents parser stack overflow & playout glitches
Deterministic Invariant (evaluateWebrtcRfc2198RedRecursive...):
clampedMaxRedBlocksPerPacket <= 2 && clampedMaxRedTimestampOffsetTicks <= 4800
Stage 396 Quantitative Verification & Measurement Provenance (399 Dimensions · 795 Guardrails · 804 Probes · 838 Unit Tests)
• FEC Anti-Spiral Gate (P785): Caps FEC <=25% BWE (0 self-congestion drops); RED Gate (P786): 0 RED-in-RED crashes & <=4,800-tick offset.
